title: fpcube: processing code for the Florida Pasture Cube

creators.name: Rodrigues, Hugo
creators.affiliation: University of Florida, Institute of Food and Agricultural Sciences, Range Cattle Research and Education Center, Ona, Florida, USA

description: Python package that builds the Florida Pasture Cube from public sources (HLS, Sentinel-1 RTC, PRISM, gNATSGO, 3DEP, C-CAP, CDL, Florida parcel data, US Drought Monitor, NASS, HURDAT2), validates it, runs the three benchmark tasks and writes the release with its datasheet, STAC catalog and checksums.
